newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIAN CLUBS HIT BY ECONOMIC CRISIS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIAN CLUBS HIT BY ECONOMIC CRISIS.

text.p: Around half of Bulgaria's 16 first division clubs will be unable to play this weekend when the national championship resumes after the winter break because of the country's economic crisis.

"Half of the teams lack money to start (the spring half of) the championship and seven or eight teams have asked us to help them financially," Bulgarian Football Union (BFU) chief Ivan Slavkov told a news conference.
Bulgaria is suffering a severe petrol and grain crisis due to a lack of funds for imports.
Slavkov said the BFU was trying to ensure teams had fuel for their buses so that they could get to games.
